body:
The selected task currently renders below the table and scrolls away (task:812bda5e156af79a did this for the Board). Give the Tasks tab the same bottom-band pattern: a collapsible pane pinned at the page bottom; collapsed shows the selected task's title and a toggle; expanded shows the full `<solace-task>`; the table takes the remaining height and scrolls; selecting another task updates the pane and expands it; no selection means no band.

Reuse the Board's markup and CSS pattern where practical, but leave out its side placement, resize grip, Copy ID control and stored per-window size. This is only the bottom collapsible band.

**Tests:** collapsed and expanded views; no selection; selecting after collapsing; the selected task still survives paging.
title: tasks: collapsible selected pane
